title: Sources: OpenAI generated about $5.7B in revenue in Q1, nearly $1B more than Anthropic (Sri Muppidi/The Information)
summary: Sri Muppidi / The Information: Sources: OpenAI generated about $5.7B in revenue in Q1, nearly $1B more than Anthropic — OpenAI generated about $5.7 billion in revenue in the first quarter, nearly $1 billion more than archrival Anthropic generated in the same period, according to two people with knowledge of the financials.
